items.statement: The investigation validates both named triselenide structures as stationary minima or reports a scientifically justified bounded failure.
items.expected: Each conformer has an auditable stationarity diagnostic and the three selenium sites remain identifiable.

items.statement: The submission computes three ^77Se shifts for each conformer with an explicit referencing convention and compares them to the supplied observed features.
items.expected: A per-conformer, per-Se shift table and explicit comparison to 422 and 816 ppm are present.

items.statement: The cis and trans triselenide conformers are reported as energetically similar on the paper's scale.
items.expected: The reported relative energy is within the source-described 1 kcal/mol near-degeneracy, or the submission transparently reports inability to establish it.

items.statement: The calculated triselenide selenium shifts provide a semiquantitative account of the weak experimental signals.
items.expected: The submission explicitly discusses correspondence of computed features with the observed approximately 422 and 816 ppm signals and uncertainty.
